name: Before the hot season
hint: Train staff, set budgets, map risk, prepare clinics and shelters

name: From a yellow alert
hint: Watch: warn the public and check on people at risk

name: From an orange alert
hint: Be prepared: open cooling spaces, shift work hours, ready hospitals

name: At a red alert
hint: Take action: every department at full response

name: After the season
hint: Count the toll, review what worked, fix it before next year

name: All year, long term
hint: Cooler buildings, greener streets, cleaner cooling
